description.value: Mercado Mexican Market & Taqueria is a Coquitlam outpost of the Restco restaurant group, combining a Mexican grocery market stocked with salsas and ready-to-cook essentials with a quick-service counter. Cyclists can fuel up on street-style tacos, burritos, quesadillas, and salad bowls made with family-rooted recipes, with several vegetarian and plant-based protein choices. The business also offers catering and wholesale products, and is part of a wider network of Mexican concepts across the Tri-Cities and Vancouver.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at mercadomexicano.ca is live and confirms the Coquitlam location at 2565 Barnet Hwy #16 with phone (604) 474-2908, validating the OSM address. The menu page explicitly lists a 'VEGETARIAN' protein option and two other plant-based proteins (Rajas con Queso, Champiñones al Ajillo), confirming vegetarian availability. A dedicated 'Quick Takeout' menu section and the homepage phrase 'quick takeout meets tradition' confirm takeout service; no evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities was found.
concerns: OSM name is 'Mercado Mexican Market & Taqueria' but the website title and branding consistently read 'Mercado Mexican Market' without 'Taqueria' — minor discrepancy, OSM name retained per policy.
OSM record has no phone number; phone (604) 474-2908 sourced from website contact page only, so contact_confirmed.phone set to null (no OSM value to cross-check).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Mexican market and taqueria with a confirmed address and active website. A practical food stop for touring cyclists on Barnet Highway.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists a 'VEGETARIAN' protein option (black bean, avocado, cheese, pico & sour cream) and two plant-based proteins: Rajas con Queso and Champiñones al Ajillo
